insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: Single Private Room (Gold/Platinum) or capped (Silver FF)
room_rent.note: Individual/Family Floater Silver & Gold: no cap except Suite/above excluded; Platinum: no cap except Suite/above. Family First Silver: ₹3,000/day or Shared Room (Option 1) or ₹5,000/day or Single Private Room (Option 2). Gold/Platinum FF: up to SI except Suite/above.

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to Sum Insured across all plans; no separate ICU sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: Zone 2 pricing option applies 20% co-pay for treatment in Mumbai (incl. Navi Mumbai & Thane), Delhi NCR, Kolkata & Gujarat. International OPD cover also has 20% co-pay. No age-based mandatory co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits: HIV ₹50k, Mental disorders ₹50k–₹1L, LASER ₹50k–₹1L, Robotic surgery ₹1L (select), Maternity plan-wise
sub_limits.note: HIV/AIDS: ₹50,000; Mental disorders: ₹50,000 (Silver/Gold) or ₹1,00,000 (Platinum) on specific conditions; LASER surgery: ₹50,000 (Gold) or ₹1,00,000 (Platinum); Robotic surgeries (non-listed): ₹1,00,000; Maternity: ₹35,000–₹2,00,000 by plan; Emergency ambulance non-network: ₹2,000/event. Most other benefits up to SI.

deductible.note: No standard deductible in base plan; deductible framework exists in policy but no fixed amount mandated in base cover.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for all illnesses except accidents from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception. Portability credit applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed specific diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, osteoarthritis, kidney disease, etc.) have 12-month waiting period. Accidents covered from day 1; cancer after 30-day wait.

maternity.note: Inbuilt benefit under Family Floater and Family First policies only (not Individual). 24 months continuous coverage required. Limits: Family First Silver ₹35,000, Gold ₹50,000, Platinum ₹1,00,000; Individual/FF Silver ₹40,000–₹80,000, Gold ₹75,000–₹1,00,000, Platinum ₹2,00,000 (worldwide excl. USA/Canada). Max 2 pregnancies/terminations lifetime.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (10%/yr); up to 200% with optional Enhanced Loyalty
cumulative_bonus.note: Base: 10% of Base SI per claim-free year, max 100% of Base SI. Optional Enhanced Loyalty Additions (paid add-on) increases rate to 20%/yr, max 200% of Base SI.

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% of Base SI (same & different illness)
restoration.note: Re-fill benefit reinstates up to 100% of Base SI once per policy year. Available for same and different illness. Not available under Family First Policy.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days preceding admission, up to Sum Insured.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 180 days following discharge, up to Sum Insured.

day_care.note: Only procedures listed in Annexure III are covered as day care. OPD treatment and diagnostic services not included under this benefit.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured if patient cannot be moved to hospital or no hospital bed available. Minimum 3 consecutive days required.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (inpatient in AYUSH hospital)
ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy inpatient treatment covered up to Sum Insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals. Pre/post-hosp also covered for AYUSH only.

organ_donor.note: Medical expenses for living organ donor's inpatient treatment for organ harvesting covered up to Sum Insured. Stem cell donation excluded except bone marrow transplant.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Sum Insured at network hospitals. At non-network hospitals, capped at ₹2,000 per event. One transfer per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.display: Covered (₹1L sub-limit on select robotic surgeries)
modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, etc. Robotic surgeries (except prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy, malignancy) capped at ₹1,00,000.

consumables.display: Not covered (listed exclusions in Annexure VII)
consumables.note: Gloves, masks, consumables listed in Annexure VII are explicitly excluded or subsumed into room/procedure charges. No consumables rider available.

global_cover.display: Inbuilt (Gold: 1 trip 15 days; Platinum: 45 days/trip); USA/Canada optional
global_cover.note: Gold plan: emergency hospitalisation outside India (excl. USA/Canada), single trip max 15 days, SI up to ₹30L. Platinum: annual multi-trip max 45 days/trip, SI up to ₹1Cr. Optional Enhanced Geographical Scope adds USA & Canada. Specified Illness cover outside India also inbuilt under Gold/Platinum.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes and 15 days for monthly instalment mode. Coverage available during grace period.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for new policies (not applicable on renewals).

portability.note: Portability permitted as per IRDAI norms. Credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, cumulative bonus and moratorium transferable to new insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), ancillary hospital charges, external congenital anomaly, circumcision (non-medical), artificial life maintenance

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident (up to ₹1Cr), Critical Illness (20 conditions, up to ₹1Cr), Enhanced Loyalty (200% CB), Hospital Cash, Health Coach, International extension (double SI/extra trips), USA & Canada scope
